verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a hosted, publishable Trust Center for prospects and customers, with a custom domain and branding. Visitors can self-serve or request sensitive security documents, and admins can approve or deny requests, enforce an NDA, and choose which content is shown. Missing for 10: evidence that live control or test status is shown publicly on the Trust Center, explicit display of certifications or badges, confirmation that the NDA is click-through rather than admin-gated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
